# <span class="en">Introduction and study context</span><span class="zh">引言与研究背景</span> {#sec-intro}

## <span class="en">A civil war that is fought township by township</span><span class="zh">一场逐个镇区展开的内战</span>

::: {.en}
Myanmar has been at war with parts of itself since independence in 1948. For
most of that time the fighting was an ethnic periphery against a Bamar
centre: ethnic armed organisations in the hills of Kachin, Shan, Kayin and
Rakhine against the national army, the Tatmadaw. The coup of 1 February 2021
changed the geography of the conflict. The military's suppression of the
protests that followed pushed a generation of activists into armed
resistance, the National Unity Government declared a "people's defensive war"
in September 2021, and local People's Defence Forces took up arms in the
Bamar lowlands, which had been largely free of armed conflict for decades
[@wiki_mmr2026]. In October 2023 an alliance of three ethnic armed
organisations launched Operation 1027 in northern Shan, and the war moved
into a phase in which the military lost territory on several fronts at once.

By late 2025 more than three million people had been displaced, and the
country was divided into zones held by the military, by ethnic armed
organisations and by resistance forces, with much of it contested. Fighting
of this kind does not happen everywhere at once or with the same intensity.
It is carried out township by township, and peace-building needs to know
where it concentrates, where it is spreading, and where it is dying down.
:::

::: {.zh}
自 1948 年独立以来,缅甸就一直与自身的一部分处于战争之中。在大部分时间里,战事
是**族群边缘对抗缅族中心**:克钦、掸、克伦与若开山地的民族武装组织对抗国家军队
(Tatmadaw)。2021 年 2 月 1 日的政变改变了冲突的地理格局。军方对随后抗议的镇压
把一代社会活动者推向武装抵抗;民族团结政府于 2021 年 9 月宣布「人民自卫战争」;
地方人民防卫军在缅族聚居的低地拿起武器,而这些地区此前数十年基本没有武装冲突
[@wiki_mmr2026]。2023 年 10 月,三个民族武装组织结成的联盟在掸邦北部发起「1027
行动」,战争进入军方在多条战线同时失地的阶段。

到 2025 年底,流离失所人数已超过三百万,国家被分割为军方控制区、民族武装控制区与
抵抗力量控制区,其中大片地区处于争夺之中。这种性质的战争不会在所有地方同时、以
同样的强度发生。它**以镇区为单位**展开,而和平建设需要知道:冲突集中在哪里,
正向哪里扩散,又在哪里逐渐平息。
:::

## <span class="en">Why local spatial statistics</span><span class="zh">为什么用局部空间统计</span>

::: {.en}
A choropleth of event counts answers the first of those questions only
loosely. A dark township may be one of a cluster of dark townships or an
isolated case, and the eye is poor at telling a real cluster from a chance
arrangement of 329 shades. Local measures of spatial association (LMSA)
formalise the comparison. Local Moran's I [@anselin1995] asks whether a
township resembles its neighbours more than chance would allow, and so
separates clusters (high among high, low among low) from spatial outliers
(high among low, low among high). Getis-Ord Gi\* [@getis1992; @ord1995] asks
whether the total in a township's neighbourhood, the township included, is
unusually large or small, and so marks hot and cold spots without
distinguishing a cluster from an outlier.

Both statistics describe one snapshot. Emerging hot spot analysis (EHSA)
extends Gi\* to a space-time cube: Gi\* is computed for every township in
every period, and a Mann-Kendall test [@mann1945; @kendall1975] on each
township's series of Gi\* values classifies the township by the trajectory
of its hot-spot status, whether new, intensifying, persistent, sporadic or
diminishing [@esri_ehsa]. The approach has been applied to gun violence
[@boschan2024], to roadkill [@kim2023] and to network events [@putrenko2018],
and the space-time dimensions of conflict events have been explored in this
way before [@mack2018].
:::

::: {.zh}
事件计数的分级设色图只能粗略地回答上面的第一个问题。一个深色镇区可能是一片深色
镇区中的一员,也可能是孤立个案;而人眼很难把真实的聚集与 329 种深浅的偶然排列
区分开来。**局部空间关联指标**(LMSA)把这一比较形式化。局部 Moran's I
[@anselin1995] 问的是:一个镇区与其邻居的相似程度是否超出偶然所能解释的范围,并
据此把**聚集**(高中之高、低中之低)与**空间异常值**(低中之高、高中之低)区分
开来。Getis-Ord Gi\* [@getis1992; @ord1995] 问的是:一个镇区所在邻域(包含其自身)
的总量是否异常地大或小,据此标出**热点与冷点**,但不区分聚集与异常值。

这两种统计量描述的都是一个截面。**新兴热点分析**(EHSA)把 Gi\* 扩展到时空立方体:
对每个镇区在每个时期计算 Gi\*,再对每个镇区的 Gi\* 序列做 Mann-Kendall 检验
[@mann1945; @kendall1975],按其热点状态的**轨迹**为镇区分类:新出现、增强、持续、
零星或减弱 [@esri_ehsa]。这一方法已被用于枪支暴力 [@boschan2024]、道路动物致死
[@kim2023] 与网络事件 [@putrenko2018],冲突事件的时空维度此前也曾用类似方式探索过
[@mack2018]。
:::

## <span class="en">Research questions</span><span class="zh">研究问题</span> {#sec-rq}

::: {.rq .en}
*RQ1 · Where.* Where are the statistically significant hot spots, cold spots
and spatial outliers of armed conflict among Myanmar's townships between
January 2021 and September 2025, and do they differ between battles, remote
violence, violence against civilians and fatalities?
:::

::: {.rq .zh}
*RQ1 · 在哪里。* 2021 年 1 月至 2025 年 9 月,缅甸各镇区武装冲突的统计显著热点、
冷点与空间异常值在哪里?它们在战斗、远程暴力、针对平民的暴力与死亡人数之间是否
不同?
:::

::: {.rq .en}
*RQ2 · How it evolves.* How has the pattern changed quarter by quarter: which
townships are new, intensifying, persistent, sporadic or diminishing hot and
cold spots?
:::

::: {.rq .zh}
*RQ2 · 如何演变。* 这一格局如何逐季度变化:哪些镇区是新出现、增强、持续、零星或
减弱的热点与冷点?
:::

::: {.rq .en}
*RQ3 · How it spreads (value-added).* Does armed conflict spread from a
township to its neighbours, and if it does, is contagion what starts
conflict in a township or what escalates it once it has started?
:::

::: {.rq .zh}
*RQ3 · 如何扩散(附加价值分析)。* 武装冲突是否会从一个镇区扩散到其邻居?如果会,
传染机制是**引发**一个镇区的冲突,还是在冲突开始之后使其**升级**?
:::

::: {.en}
RQ1 is answered in @sec-lmsa, RQ2 in @sec-ehsa and RQ3 in @sec-va. Before
any of them, @sec-prep sets out the data preparation, because several of the
results depend on decisions taken there. @sec-assump collects the analytical
assumptions in one place.
:::

::: {.zh}
RQ1 在 @sec-lmsa 回答,RQ2 在 @sec-ehsa,RQ3 在 @sec-va。在此之前,@sec-prep 交代
数据准备,因为若干结果取决于在那里做出的决定;@sec-assump 则把分析假设集中列出。
:::
